[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} [[Geode]]s are shining rocks that are hoarded by the beetles in [[Vabbi]]. == Acquisition == * [[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]] ** [[Vabbi]] *** [[Rain Beetle]] *** [[Rock Beetle]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Geode#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[The Mirror of Lyss]]==== Exit southeast from [[Mihanu Township]]. Go a short distance along the north wall to a group of five beetles. From here go southeast - sticking close to the scarp to avoid any other [[creature]]s - to another group of five beetles. Continue south and find two more groups, weaving between [[patrol]]s to avoid [[aggro]]. The run ends at [[the Kodash Bazaar]], allowing you to zone back into the Mirror of Lyss to repeat the route in reverse. The drop rate seems to average 1 Geode per beetle group every 3 minutes (or total of 4-5 per run). The run takes 12-15 minutes. ==Collectors== {{:Kurmauzeh/Collector}} {{:Olujime/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|3rd October 2011 and 5th May 2014|Yatendi Canyons|1 [[Geode]]}}
